findings.description: Unavailable motion-evidence coverage becomes a clean result. shape accepts null without checking the annotation, and W1 recognizes only the literal 'unknown'. With coverage=null, neither the UNKNOWN branch nor the still-frame branch fires. Independently reproduced through query using an in-memory SQLite database containing a typed motion observation, retained evidence, matching media/timeline and corrected hash pins: status=COMPLETE, ready=true, findings=[], unknown=[]. Direct evaluate also silently passes omitted coverage.

The hypothesis warrant branch cannot succeed for normally admitted records: TerminalVerdict.intent must be IntentSpecV2, while Hypothesis.intent must be IntentSpec. The positive test changes the hypothesis to IntentSpecV2 and bypasses admission. Independently confirmed that model validation rejects that fixture. Also persisted a verdict citing a legacy hypothesis, its warranted support relation, explicit MUST relevance, and a same-media v2 fulfills relation anchored to that MUST criterion; lint still emitted E1. The checker ignores the existing relevance mapping and evidence-to-intent path.

Reference discovery treats every dictionary containing kind and id as a Ref. TestPlan.predictions is keyed by arbitrary hypothesis IDs, so a valid plan for hypotheses named 'kind' and 'id' is reported as INTEGRITY_FAILURE with 'reference requires explicit revision'. Independently constructed and persisted those hypotheses, their CompetingSet and the TestPlan successfully, then reproduced the false lint rejection. Existing TestPlan validation explicitly preserves predictions as a data mapping.

LintResult is registered but has no admission check for its input digest pins or aggregate input identity. Generic reference validation checks existence only, and the specialized admission dispatcher excludes LintResult. Independently persisted and reloaded a COMPLETE, ready=true audit whose existing dataset input had an incorrect all-f digest and whose input_sha256 was 'not-a-digest'. Snapshot/export integrity checks validate the outer artifact digest, not these claimed input identities.
